notes: §1985:IX.4.9.3 SR1 as amended: "If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it must reference an alphanumeric function. Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not reference the same storage area." KeyedIoBinder.BindWrite binds FROM through MoveBinder.BindFromPhrase, which asks StatementValidation.CheckPhraseOperandIsNotRecordArea (RecordAreaRule.InForce: Year < 2023, decided by StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf) and screens a function's category (COBOL1914). Probes (work-rd-09/ov): refused: FROM the record itself (the witness), FROM another 01 of the FD, FROM a subordinate X(10) at offset 0 of full width, FROM FUNCTION LENGTH / RANDOM / ORD (numeric, COBOL1914); accepted and run: FROM a W-S item, FUNCTION UPPER-CASE / CURRENT-DATE / REVERSE; edition arm: FROM a literal or ZERO is COBOL0871 at 85, and WRITE IXR FROM IXR compiles at 2023. NOT implemented for two shapes that name exactly the record area: a reference modification spanning the whole record (IXR(1:), IXR(1:10)) and a level-66 RENAMES of the record's first THRU last item; IsRecordAreaOf excludes a reference-modified operand and a RENAMES alias by design (its doc comment), though both denote the identical storage it refuses under a subordinate name. Minor: COBOL1914's text at --std 85 quotes §2023:14.9.51.3 SR4 ('alphanumeric or national function'), not the 1985 sentence. Partial overlap (FROM IXK, a 4-character prefix) is accepted, which 'the same storage area' does not reach. kb/Work PB5412 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read3/rd-09.json). || RE-VERDICTED CONFORMS (kb/Work PB5412, wave 20262025 group B): StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf decides 'the same storage area' on the storage the operand denotes (StorageExtent.OfReference), not on its form, so a literal reference modification of the whole record (R (1:10); R (1:) whatever R's length), the element of a table of one occurrence and a 66 THROUGH alias of the whole record are refused COBOL6827, and a SAME AREA peer's record is the area too (1985:VII.2.13.4 GR1, FileModel.StorageSharingFiles); docs/FILES_DESIGN.md D31(b) is revised. The read-3 and read-4 probes are all refused now. The function sentence's COBOL1914 message now cites the 1985 rule of the file's module (kb/Work PB5486: FromPhraseRules.FunctionRuleCite is an EditionCite).

next.reason: §1985:IX.4.9.3 SR1 as amended: 'If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it must reference an alphanumeric function. Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not reference the same storage area.' X3.23a-1989 added the function sentence; X3.23b-1993 restored the storage sentence to an unconditional one (the 1985 print: 'must not refer to the same storage area'). (a) Function: §2023:14.9.51.3 SR4 ('it shall reference an alphanumeric or national function') and §2023:14.9.51.3 SR11 ('identifier-1 shall reference an alphanumeric, boolean, or national function'): the words 'or national' and 'boolean' widen what is accepted. (b) Storage: 2023 has no syntax rule refusing the overlap. §2023:14.9.51.4 GR5 makes WRITE ... FROM a MOVE to the record followed by the WRITE, and its NOTE 1 applies 14.6.10 and the MOVE rules 'to any cases in which the storage area identified by identifier-1 and the record area associated with record-name-1 share any part of their storage areas', the WRITE being 'undefined if the result of execution of the implicit MOVE statement' is; §2023:14.6.10 GR1: 'the result of the statement is undefined' unless, §2023:14.6.10 GR2, the items share a data description entry ('the same as if the data items shared no part'); §2023:14.9.51.4 GR9 contemplates identifier-1 being 'one or part of one of the record descriptions'. A source 1985 refuses is accepted, with a defined or an undefined result and no exception condition.
